summary: An Oak Alley-type Greek Revival mansion: a 44x20 white two-storey block on a red-brick base. Eight colossal 2x2 quartz columns carry a full-width double gallery, and one low slate hip with a dentil cornice, three front dormers and four brick chimneys covers both. A rear T-wing holds the vaulted living room and the open kitchen. It reads as a plantation house because of the oak allee drive, the colonnade, the parterre and fountain, the outbuildings and the river dock. plan.md is written; the roof heights are estimates and haven't been dry-run with `mcd roof` yet. Oak Alley-type white Greek Revival mansion: 8 colossal columns carrying a double gallery under a low slate hip with dormers and 4 chimneys. Central hall with a grand stair; vaulted living room open to the kitchen in the rear T-wing; 8 bedrooms (master suite east front with its own bath, opening onto the upper porch). Gravel drive between 8 live oaks, a parterre with fountain, a greenhouse, a gazebo, a carriage house and a guest cottage, and a river dock.
